characters.name: Plum Blossom Blade
characters.description: White murim robes, pink plum petals, and a long gleaming sword.

traits.hair: Long neat black hair tied partly back
traits.outfit: White murim martial robes with soft pink sash accents
traits.props: MUST hold ONE long straight sword clearly in hand
traits.aura: A few floating pink plum blossom petals around the figure (compact)

characters.name: Tower Ranker
characters.description: Long blue coat, black hair, and a compact pocket-glow aura.

traits.outfit: Long blue trench coat over dark clothes and boots
traits.props: MUST show a glowing rectangular pocket device on the belt or in one hand
traits.aura: Soft cool blue pocket-glow particles behind the figure

characters.name: Fourth-wall Reader
characters.description: White coat, black hair, and a subtle crack-ink aura.

traits.eyes: Tired dark eyes with thin glasses
traits.outfit: Long white coat over plain dark shirt and pants
traits.props: MUST hold a closed hardcover book under one arm
traits.aura: Subtle black ink crack lines behind the figure (no text, no UI)

characters.name: Absolute Regressor
characters.description: Black coat, red time-fracture aura, and a single sword.

traits.outfit: Black high-collar coat, dark armor accents, boots
traits.props: MUST hold ONE sword clearly visible
traits.aura: Jagged red time-fracture shards behind the silhouette

characters.name: Ice Sovereign
characters.description: White-blue hair, crystalline dress, and an ice spear.

traits.outfit: Crystalline ice-blue gown with silver trim and boots
traits.props: MUST hold ONE crystalline ice spear

characters.name: Flame Returnee

traits.outfit: Charred dark coat with ember lining, dark pants, boots

characters.name: Blood Contract

characters.name: Academy Prodigy
